evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel C and C++ API in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, replacing btck_LoggingConnection with btck_logging_set_callback.
rationale: Corrects misleading API semantics where per-connection handles implied independent logging instances over a process-wide singleton. Reviewers note it is pragmatic and simpler for external callers, and it unblocks #34374 without being urgent.
